subject: Campus consortium - eligibility for academic/accelerator rate exception
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@greenfield.edu>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@greenfield.edu
Date: 2026-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Campus consortium pricing inquiry

Hi Ben,

I'm reaching out on behalf of the Greenfield University Consortium (a group of 6 regional colleges plus our attached 3 early-stage campus startups in the accelerator). We're evaluating hosted API vendors for a campuswide license and trying to understand whether Redwood offers any academic/consortium pricing that could extend to accelerator startups affiliated with member campuses.

Key constraints: budget approval is on June 25; procurement will prefer a single PO for the consortium; accelerator startups would be paid seats but need preferential per-token pricing to keep pilot costs reasonable.

Could you share your academic rate card and any guidance on exceptions for campus accelerators? If a usage commitment or LOI is required to qualify, please let us know what those thresholds look like.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Director, Innovation & Partnerships
Greenfield University
procurement@greenfield.edu

-----
Attachment: none

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@greenfield.edu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Campus consortium pricing inquiry

Hi Elena —

Great to meet you (virtually). Short answer: yes, we have academic pricing and a campus-consortium path that can include affiliated startups, but there are a couple of common guardrails (usage commitment, single-bill for the consortium, and a short evaluation window for the accelerator startups). I attached our current Edu rate card (PDF) and a short note on standard qualifying terms.

If you can share ballpark monthly token volume across the consortium (or expected seats for each accelerator), I can run scenarios and propose a concrete exception if needed. If procurement prefers, we can also draft a LOI that specifies commitment terms to get you the discount.

Looping in Marissa from Pricing to help with the numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Education & Research
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Ben — attached is a short summary of expected usage for the first 12 months (we included estimated accelerator pilot usage). A few clarifying points:

- Consortium expects ~1.2M tokens/month aggregate in year 1 (search + student-facing chat).
- Accelerator cohort (3 startups) forecast ~120k tokens/month combined for a 6-month pilot.
- Budget authority requests an example of a rate exception and any required minimum commit to get the university/accelerator pricing.

I've attached a draft LOI template our counsel uses; feel free to annotate rather than rewrite.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: Greenfield_LOI_draft.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@greenfield.edu>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Campus consortium pricing inquiry

Hi Elena — thanks for the numbers. I ran a quick model against the Edu rate card and a few exception scenarios:

- Standard academic tier: 25% off list for verified institution volume (no startup inclusion).
- Consortium + single-bill + 12-month minimum commit (1.0M tokens/month floor): 30% off list.
- Consortium + accelerator inclusion (up to 150k tokens/month) + 12-month commit + accelerator LOI: 35% off list.

Notes: To qualify for the accelerator inclusion, we require the startups to be officially affiliated with member campuses and for the consortium PO/LOI to list them as covered entities for the pilot period. The discount and the accelerator allowance are conditioned on a minimum month-to-month floor for the consortium (we can bottle the accelerator usage separately in billing but it needs to be under the same commercial agreement).

Ben — can you confirm whether Greenfield will accept a 12-month term with a 1M tokens/month floor? If yes, we can prepare a customer-facing quote and a redline to the LOI that marks the covered startups.

Marissa Cole
Pricing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@greenfield.edu>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Campus consortium pricing inquiry

Marissa — this looks promising. Two procurement questions from counsel: 1) can we get the accelerator startups classified as "campus-affiliated" with a short affidavit instead of adding them as named entities on the PO? 2) is the 12-month minimum flexible if we tie a modest consumption ramp (e.g., 6 months at 60% of floor, then backfill to full floor)?

If you can annotate the LOI showing those flex points, procurement will review next week and we hope to get sign-off by June 25.

Thanks,
Elena

Hi all — jumping in from Sales Leadership. We can approve an accelerator-inclusive concession under the following commercial guardrails:

1) 12-month agreement with the 1.0M tokens/month floor. We will allow a staged ramp: months 1–3 at 60% of floor, months 4–6 at 80%, months 7–12 at 100% (cumulative must meet the annualized floor).
2) Accelerator startups may be covered via a campus-affiliation affidavit for the pilot (legal will confirm the affidavit language); we do not require each to be a named PO payee provided the consortium agrees to indemnity and standard data protections.
3) Discount: 35% off list for consortium volume up to 1.5M tokens/month; overage tiers apply at 45% of list price per additional 500k tokens.
4) Eligible only if a signed LOI or PO is executed by June 30, 2026 and a HubSpot deal is created (Deal ID: RGF-2026-042).

Ben/Marissa — I'll ask Legal to add the affidavit template and I'll get Finance to prepare a quote deck so procurement can see exact numbers. Elena — if that timeline works, please confirm and we'll generate a DocuSign LOI and a formal quote.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
